mistral/annotations/mistral-ocr-4-1.note: OCR 4.1 card: $5 per 1000 annotated pages. Not confirmed whether this includes the $4 per 1000 OCR pages.

reducto/deep-extract.note: Deep Extract list price $40 per 1,000 pages (also https://docs.reducto.ai/reference/credit-usage.md, effective 2026-09-01). Parse included. Dense extractions over 100 fields per page may add an unpublished per-field surcharge; the generator then reports cost n/a. Credit-based accounts: no published price per credit, cost n/a.

llamaextract/agentic-plus.note: Pay as you go $1.50 per 1,000 credits. Agentic Plus: 50 extract credits + 10 Agentic parse credits = 60 credits per page ($0.09). Cost uses the credits the job reports; perPage only when they are missing.
